hero.label: About the workshop
hero.p1: We create exclusive bumpers, body kits and custom headlights that can't be bought in a store. Every piece is born in a single copy — made specifically for your car and your style.
hero.p2: МОЙКАСТОМ workshop is a place where mass-production solutions don't matter. Only handmade work, only a personal approach, and only unique custom.

items.title: Exclusive bumpers "like no one else's"
items.desc: We design and manufacture custom bumpers that integrate perfectly into your car's design. No ready-made shapes — only 3D modeling for your geometry and wishes.

items.title: Body kits — pure individuality
items.desc: Side skirts, splitters, diffusers, arch extenders. We create body kits of any complexity: from aggressive tuning style to refined classics. Every element is a single copy.

items.title: Custom headlights — light that stands out
items.desc: We design custom headlights with unique graphics, DRL LEDs, projector lenses and laser technology. It's not just light — it's architecture.

items.title: Full turnkey cycle
items.desc: From sketch and 3D printing to painting and installation. You get a ready unique custom piece without having to look for other craftsmen.

process.label: Creation process

steps.title: Concept
steps.desc: We discuss the idea, references, technical tasks — you become a co-author of the piece.

steps.title: 3D project
steps.desc: We model the part specifically for your car's geometry — no universal shapes.

steps.title: Production
steps.desc: Carbon, fiberglass, ABS plastic or 3D printing — we choose the material for the task.

steps.title: Finish
steps.desc: Fitting, primer, painting, polishing — the piece is ready for turnkey installation.

process.guaranteeText: You won't find the same headlights or the same bumper on another car — because every piece is made for you. The sketch goes into the archive, drawings are not resold, there are no molds. Even if someone orders the same body kit twice — we will refuse.

forWho.label: Custom or tuning?
forWho.p1: If you need ready-made parts from a catalog — that's not us. We create custom tuning where you're the co-author. Unique custom suits:
forWho.whyLabel: Why a "single copy" is a technology
whyItems: No molds or dies — every project from scratch
No reselling of drawings — the sketch is yours
You own the design — the part belongs to you
